Usecase fecharComanda is already chosen. Do not rename it.
Entity Comanda. Operation transition. Storage moduleDatabase.
MDM namespace: (none).

This operation is the lifecycle transition fecharComanda.

O caixa registra o desconto opcional e a forma de pagamento, fecha a comanda e libera a mesa para novo atendimento.

Port ComandaRepository
transition(Comanda, transitionId): Comanda

Effect comandaFechada
On: Comanda.fecharComanda
Kind: event

Publica a comanda fechada, incluindo o pagamento registrado, para o módulo financeiro.

Plan steps only. Do not write TypeScript. Do not invent a field, a rule, an operation, a route or a type.
A transition payload may list only a path the operation input or the lifecycle payload already lists.
More than one repository write needs one local transaction boundary. Separate MDM facade calls are not one transaction. An external effect is not atomic.
Authority is ctx.

Each step is one kind. A step may name only the keys of that kind:
- port: kind, call, port
  call: transition
  port: ComandaRepository
- transition: kind, transitionId, payload
  transitionId: fecharComanda
  payload: details.discountAmount, details.paymentMethod
- effect: kind, eventId
  eventId: comandaFechada
- transaction: kind, boundary
  boundary: local
- context: kind, source
  source: ctx
A key from another kind is refused.
